topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
stemEn: The family of a 12-year-old girl is concerned about the safety and side effects of MMR and HPV vaccines. What is the best way to convince them?

options.text: Encourage them to talk with other parents
Give them scientific materials about vaccine safety
Tell them about consequences of not receiving vaccination

explanationAr: المصدر يختار إعطاء scientific materials موثوقة مع counseling مباشر من pediatrician. الفكرة الأساسية هي احترام مخاوف الأسرة وتقديم evidence واضح بدل التخويف أو الاعتماد على تجارب الآخرين.
reasoningEn: The source emphasizes informed, respectful counseling and reputable vaccine-safety information.
incorrectOptionsAr: الاعتماد على parents آخرين أقل موثوقية، والتخويف من consequences وحده ليس أفضل strategy للتواصل.
clinicalPearl: A strong, respectful clinician recommendation is one of the most effective tools against vaccine hesitancy.

topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
stemEn: A 3-year-old child did not receive vaccines after age 2 months. Which vaccines should be given at this visit?

options.text: HBV, HAV, DTaP, IPV, PCV13, MCV4, MMR
HBV, HAV, DTaP, IPV, PCV13, MCV4, MMR, Varicella

explanationAr: المصدر يختار B ويذكر أن rotavirus وBCG لا يُعطيان في هذا العمر ضمن catch-up المذكور. لأن Saudi vaccination schedule تتغير، لا نعتمد القائمة كـ current verified schedule قبل مراجعة MOH الحالية.
reasoningEn: The source's catch-up key excludes BCG and rotavirus at age three.
incorrectOptionsAr: المصدر يستبعد BCG وrotavirus بسبب age limits/schedule framing المستخدم في الملف.
clinicalPearl: Catch-up schedules are time-sensitive; never restart a vaccine series unnecessarily, but use the current national schedule.

stemEn: What are the recent changes to the Saudi vaccination schedule?

options.text: IPV, OPV, DTaP, hepatitis B, Hib, PCV, BCG at age 6 months
Tdap and HPV at age 11 years

explanationAr: المصدر نفسه يقول إن الإجابة تعتمد على الخيارات ويطلب مراجعة old/new Saudi schedule. السؤال غير صالح للنشر كـ fixed answer لأن كلمة recent تتغير مع الزمن.
reasoningEn: The source provides no stable answer and explicitly flags schedule changes.
clinicalPearl: Questions framed as 'recent schedule changes' must be versioned by year and verified against current MOH guidance.

topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
stemEn: A mother of a 7-month-old preterm infant born at 30 weeks asks about influenza vaccine. What should you tell her?
explanationAr: المصدر يذكر أن الأطفال 6 أشهر–8 سنوات عند first influenza vaccination يحتاجون جرعتين بفاصل 4 أسابيع؛ prematurity لا يمنع التطعيم حسب chronological age.
reasoningEn: The source frames this as a first-time influenza vaccination in an infant older than six months.
incorrectOptionsAr: LAIV intranasal غير مناسب لهذا العمر، وعدم التطعيم خاطئ حسب المصدر.
clinicalPearl: Use chronological age for routine vaccination of preterm infants unless a specific exception applies.

topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
subtopic: Live vaccines and pregnant household contact
stemEn: A pregnant mother at 17 weeks asks whether her infant should receive the upcoming 12-month vaccines that include live attenuated vaccines. What should you tell her?

options.text: Do not give varicella and MMR vaccines

explanationAr: وجود pregnant household contact ليس contraindication لتطعيم طفل سليم بـMMR/varicella وفق framing المصدر؛ بالعكس تطعيم household contacts يقلل exposure risk.
reasoningEn: Routine live vaccines can generally be given to healthy household contacts of pregnant persons.
incorrectOptionsAr: حجب MMR/varicella عن الطفل فقط لأن الأم حامل ليس ما يوصي به المصدر.
clinicalPearl: The contraindication applies to vaccinating the pregnant person with certain live vaccines, not generally to healthy household contacts.

stemEn: PPSV23 vaccine is indicated for which of the following?

options.text: 12-year-old patient with previous severe pneumococcal disease

explanationAr: المصدر القديم يختار HIV بعمر 13 سنة، لكن pneumococcal schedules تغيرت مع PCV15/PCV20 وتحديثات risk-based vaccination؛ لذلك لا نثبت الإجابة كcurrent recommendation قبل verification.
reasoningEn: The source key is C, but the pneumococcal schedule is highly time-sensitive.
clinicalPearl: Risk-based pneumococcal vaccine questions should be tied to a guideline year/version.

topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
stemEn: A child returned from Pakistan without receiving prophylactic travel vaccines and now has bloody diarrhea. What is the most likely cause?
explanationAr: السفر للIndian subcontinent مع GI illness هو clue المصدر لـtyphoid/Salmonella. الملف يذكر ارتفاع risk للمسافرين إلى Pakistan والمنطقة.
reasoningEn: The source uses travel to Pakistan plus bloody diarrhea as the clue for Salmonella typhi.
incorrectOptionsAr: Malaria لا تفسر bloody diarrhea عادةً؛ TB/HepA لا يطابقان presentation الحاد.
clinicalPearl: Returning traveler fever/diarrhea requires broader differential and exposure history than this recall alone.

topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
stemEn: A 6-year-old presented with a puncture wound from a rusty nail with laceration. Vaccination status is unknown. What should be given?

options.text: Tetanus toxoid-containing vaccine and tetanus immune globulin

explanationAr: المصدر يختار tetanus toxoid-containing vaccine + TIG عند dirty/puncture wound مع unknown vaccination status.
reasoningEn: Unknown or incomplete tetanus immunization with a tetanus-prone wound triggers active plus passive prophylaxis in the source.
incorrectOptionsAr: Td وحده لا يوفر passive protection عندما history غير معروف في tetanus-prone wound؛ no prophylaxis غير مناسب.
clinicalPearl: Tetanus prophylaxis depends on wound type and documented primary series/last dose.

topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
stemEn: A 6-year-old presented with a 3-cm puncture wound from a rusty nail. His last tetanus-containing vaccine was at age 18 months. What should be given now?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار nothing. عمر 6 سنوات مع آخر جرعة عند 18 شهرًا يعني قرابة 4.5 سنوات؛ في tetanus-prone wounds الحد التاريخي المستخدم في المصدر هو booster إذا مضى ≥5 سنوات بشرط primary series complete. لكن لأن تفاصيل السلسلة الكاملة غير مذكورة، يبقى السؤال للمراجعة.
reasoningEn: The source key appears to rely on the less-than-five-year interval since the last dose, assuming a complete primary series.
clinicalPearl: Do not infer a complete tetanus primary series unless the stem supports it.

stemEn: An 11-year-old presented with a small puncture wound from a rusty nail. His last tetanus-containing vaccine was at age 4 years. What should be given?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار Td، لكن في current schedules قد يكون Tdap هو age-appropriate product إذا لم يُعط سابقًا. لذلك نحفظ recalledAnswer فقط ونعلّم السؤال outdated/needs verification.
reasoningEn: The historical recall key is Td; current adolescent tetanus-containing vaccine recommendations may differ.
clinicalPearl: Tetanus product choice is age- and prior-Tdap-dependent, so old exam keys can become outdated.

topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
stemEn: A 6-year-old child was bitten by an immunized dog. The child is vaccinated up to age and has a superficial forearm abrasion. What should be done next?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار wound irrigation/debridement كأساس أولي. الحاجة إلى antibiotics أو rabies/tetanus prophylaxis تعتمد على wound severity، الحيوان، المكان، وvaccination history.
reasoningEn: Immediate wound cleansing and irrigation is the core first step in the recalled uncomplicated superficial bite.
incorrectOptionsAr: Prophylactic antibiotics ليست مطلوبة لكل superficial bite. Rabies/tetanus decisions تحتاج risk assessment ولا تُعطى تلقائيًا من هذا stem.
clinicalPearl: Bite management always begins with meticulous wound cleansing plus risk-based rabies/tetanus assessment.

topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
stemEn: What prophylactic antibiotic will you use for a fully vaccinated child who was bitten by a cat?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار amoxicillin-clavulanate. ويذكر أن PREP variants التي استخدمت clindamycin + TMP-SMX كانت في penicillin-allergic patients؛ لذلك allergy status يغيّر الإجابة.
reasoningEn: Amoxicillin-clavulanate is the source's prophylactic choice for a cat bite when penicillin allergy is not stated.
incorrectOptionsAr: Erythromycin أو ceftriaxone ليسا مفتاح المصدر للprophylaxis الروتينية في هذا السؤال.
clinicalPearl: Cat bites are puncture-prone; antibiotic prophylaxis decisions depend on wound location/depth and host factors.
